reasoning_summary: The defect is a fundamental error in the mathematical formula used to calculate the chi-square statistic. Since the fix involves rewriting the computational logic within the method to use the correct arithmetic operation, it is classified as an Algorithm/Method defect.
evidence_used: The bug report states: 'In AbstractLeastSquares, residualsWeights contains the WEIGHTS assigned to each observation... unlike in getChiSquare() where it appears at the denominator!'
